quota.description: 官方逐字 50 agentic requests per month；另有 1,000 lines of code per month（用于 Java 升级，单位是「行」）写在 restrictions 里，不塞进 amount。

restrictions.note: 官方逐字：available to users logged in as an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) user or AWS Builder ID user.

evidence.quote: Amazon Q Developer offers a perpetual Free Tier with monthly limits available to users logged in as an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) user or AWS Builder ID user.

billing.note: 官方逐字 $19/mo. per user、charged per user, per month（首月按天折算）。时效事实（官方产品页逐字公告）：2027-04-30 起 AWS 将停止支持 Amazon Q Developer IDE 插件，官方建议改用 Kiro。完整引文与出处见本条 evidence（字段 billing.note）。

quota.description: 额度单位是**提交的行数（LOC）**，不是 token/积分/请求数 ⇒ 按 other 记并写明口径、不折算。官方逐字：4,000 lines of code per month per user pooled at account level; extra lines at $.003 per LOC submitted.

restrictions.note: 官方逐字：allocations aggregated at the AWS payer-account level every month；超额 $0.003/LOC。
